name: OneSAF (One Semi-Automated Forces)
description: U.S. Army constructive simulation system for battalion-and-below training and mission rehearsal. Models individual soldier and vehicle behaviors with emergent unit-level tactics. Designed to replace legacy SAF systems with a single, composable simulation architecture.
reputation: U.S. Army standard constructive simulation for home-station and combat training center exercises
notes: Composable architecture allows configuration from individual soldier level to brigade. Supports HLA federation with other simulation systems. Used at combat training centers and home-station training.

institutions: U.S. Army Program Executive Office for Simulation, Training and Instrumentation (PEO STRI)
